end.summary: Discussed everyday ways to keep school clean, green, and safe.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting wet waste into the green bin and discussing compost, including leaves, shade, air, and turning the compost. They explained that litter can attract cockroaches and suggested putting cups in the dustbin. Anika still mixed up the idea that keeping school clean is mainly staff's job, and that foil or plastic can turn into compost; neither mix-up was corrected by the end. At home, practise sorting a few household items into wet and dry waste and explain why plastic stays out of compost.
